Propose ordered ten + two, retaining assimilation, Kannada h-/zero-initial variants and the survey vowel notation. These are whole-numeral comparative analyses, with no truncation of source responses; contact-sensitive Gondi/Gadaba/Konda sets are excluded.

proposals.evidence: Propose ordered four × ten. DEDR3655 and3918 explicitly give Tamil nāṟpatu/nāppatu, Malayalam nālpatu, Kannada nālvattu and Kota nālvat forty. Survey forms are comparative variants of these formations, preserving assimilation, reduced vowels and final vowels. No independent one-stem etymology is substituted for the two numeral components.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4990 explicitly gives Tamil/Malayalam muḻaṅ kai elbow, Kannada moḻa key, Kodagu moḷa kay and Kota mogay/mogī; DEDR2023 supplies hand. Propose ordered joint + hand for these southern survey elbow responses, retaining lateral/nasal variants, assimilation and the contracted Muthuvan mū̃kay/Irula muŋgoi shapes. These minority-lect correspondences are comparative proposals.
